insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Annual Sum Insured (exact amount not provided in shared pages; as per Policy Schedule). Also mentions Deductible-based Top-up/Super Top-up variants.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “Reset Benefit... We will reset up to 100% of the Sum insured once in a policy year... in case the Sum insured including accrued Loyalty Bonus(if any) is insufficient...”
great.explanation: The policy resets up to 100% of the Sum Insured once per policy year if the base Sum Insured and Loyalty Bonus are insufficient. This provides an extra buffer to increase claim capacity within the same year.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: “Code- Excl03: 30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents, which are covered immediately. This is a standard initial waiting period in the industry.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy...”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 24 months from policy start, which is the industry standard waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Code- Excl02... listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...”
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures are excluded for 24 months, which aligns with typical market practice.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred by You up to 60-days immediately prior to Your Hospitalization”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered, allowing for diagnostic and consultation costs before admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred by You up to 90-days immediately post Hospitalization”
good.explanation: Follow-up medical expenses up to 90 days after discharge are covered, supporting recovery after hospitalization.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: “We will cover medical expenses for: • Hospital room rent”
bad.explanation: The policy does not specify any room rent limits or categories, creating uncertainty about coverage and possible restrictions or proportionate deductions.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: No clause found stating restore/reinstatement of Sum Insured (separate from Reset Benefit).
bad.explanation: No restore benefit is stated, so the Sum Insured is not replenished after claims beyond the Reset Benefit, limiting coverage for repeated illnesses.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Non Payables... List of Non Payable Items as per IRDAI... 56 GLOVES... 60 MASK...”
bad.explanation: Many consumables like gloves and masks are explicitly excluded, which means you may have to pay for these out of pocket.

bad.name: Reset Restriction
bad.quote: “For plans with Deductible ₹ 3lacs and above... The reset amount can only be used for all future claims within the same policy year, not related to the illness/disease/injury for which a claim has been paid in that policy year for the same person”
bad.explanation: Reset Benefit is limited to unrelated illnesses and only available for plans with deductibles of ₹3 lakh or more, reducing its usefulness for recurring conditions.

bad.name: NCB
bad.quote: “Loyalty Bonus... For each completed and continuous Policy Year subject to a maximum of 50% 10%” AND “our liability... shall not exceed the Annual Sum Insured (including Loyalty Bonus) ... based on Claim settled under the Policy.”
bad.reference: Section 2.A.9 (Page 10) and definition of Annual Sum Insured (Page 1)
bad.explanation: Loyalty Bonus appears capped and may be reduced or reset after claims, offering weaker protection compared to non-resetting no-claim bonuses.

bad.name: Excluded Providers
bad.quote: “Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital... specifically excluded by the Insurer... are not admissible. However, in case of life threatening situations or following an accident, expenses up to the stage of stabilization are payable but not the complete claim.”
bad.explanation: Claims for treatment at excluded or delisted hospitals may be denied beyond stabilization, risking partial claim payouts.

bad.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
bad.quote: “Domiciliary Hospitalisation benefits... shall not cover... Asthma... Bronchitis... Diabetes... Hypertension... Influenza, Cough and Cold... Arthritis, Gout and Rheumatism”
bad.explanation: Domiciliary hospitalization excludes many common chronic and respiratory conditions, limiting coverage for home-based treatment.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “We are not liable to pay twenty percent (20%) of admissible claim amount above the Deductible... for insured(s) above 60 years of age... However, this condition will not be applicable if You were aged 45 years or below at the time of buying this policy first time with Us and have renewed it continuously after that.”
bad.explanation: A 20% co-pay applies only to insured persons above 60 years, with a waiver if the policy was bought before age 45 and renewed continuously. This is a common senior co-pay structure.

unclear.name: NCB Reset
unclear.quote: “Loyalty Bonus...” (no explicit statement found on whether it reduces/resets after claims or is added irrespective of claims)
unclear.explanation: The policy does not clearly state whether the Loyalty Bonus resets or reduces after claims, so its impact on renewal benefits is uncertain.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: “Cashless treatment is only available at a Network Provider (List of Network Provider is available at our website... )”
unclear.explanation: The policy mentions a network for cashless treatment but does not specify the number of hospitals, so the network size and convenience are unclear.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
